title: L3 Readiness Input
description: The check at Gateway_L3Ready of smart-guideline-end-to-end, between stages 5 and 6: the L1 knowledge graph, the L2 assets of stage 4 with the review each has had requested, and the L3 artefacts stage 6 is about to write.

l2Assets.description: The artifacts of every stage-4 l2-dak-authoring pass.

reviews.description: One entry per stage-2 extraction and per L2 asset whose review has been requested (a Process_Review item opened and staged). An asset with no entry has not had its review requested.

l3Planned.description: The L3 artefacts stage 6 is about to write, each with the L2 asset it implements. Empty or absent means stage 6 has not planned any yet, and the check covers the L1 and L2 side only.

l1Extraction.title: L1 extraction
l1Extraction.description: One source's L1 knowledge graph. Defined by the recommendation-extraction output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

id.description: The library id of the source.

coverage.description: Share of the source's recommendation sentences extracted verbatim; the gate is 1.

warnings.description: Every WARNING, verbatim: no persona or process fitted, a sentence not matched, and so on.

skipped.description: True when the extraction was already there at this sourceVersion and was not redone.

l1Kg.title: L1 knowledge graph
l1Kg.description: Stage 2's output and the L1 input of stages 3 and 5: one extraction per included source. Defined by the recommendation-extraction output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

l2Artifact.title: L2 artifact
l2Artifact.description: One L2 asset the authoring wrote. Defined by the l2-dak-authoring output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

useCase.title: Use case
useCase.description: What the guideline is for, in the requester's words. Stage 0's output and every later stage's context. Defined by the guideline-use-case output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

setting.description: Where care happens: community, primary care, hospital, and so on.

jurisdiction.description: WHO (a global guideline) or the country or region adapting one; an ISO 3166 code where there is one.

kind.description: A new guideline, or an adaptation of an existing one.

adapts.description: For an adaptation: the guideline or DAK being adapted, by name or canonical.

reviewRequest.title: Review request
reviewRequest.description: That a review of one asset was requested: the item opened and staged. The verdict is not awaited (adjudication is QA, not a gate).

asset.description: The path of the L2 asset, or of the l1-extraction directory.

item.description: Path or URL of the review item (a Process_Review instance, an issue or a PR comment).

staged.description: The staged page the reviewer reads.

l3Planned.title: Planned L3 artefact
l3Planned.description: One L3 artefact stage 6 will write: fhir-harness l3-fhir-authoring's artifactType, and its sourceModel, which is an l2Assets path.

sourceModel.description: The path of the L2 asset it implements.
